facts.statement: DMart's retail model operates successfully across various states including Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Andhra Pradesh.
facts.quote: the fact that a DMart now is equally successful in the Punjab, as well as Tamil Nadu, as well as Rajasthan, Gujarat or in AP, in fact, simplifies a lot of things from an operating standpoint.

facts.statement: A large component of general merchandise and apparel in DMart stores consists of private labels or pseudo private labels.
facts.quote: They are actually all private labels or pseudo private labels.

facts.statement: Deflation in staples results in a huge volume pickup in those categories.
facts.quote: So, whenever there is a deflation, you get huge volume pickup in those categories.
